entities.justification: Named as the buyer of the garden in the opening section of the entry: 'is ipse Joannes Sixt per emptionem praesentem in possessione praefati Horti'.
The court where the plenipotentiary is to act: 'in Exposito Judicio Civili proxime celebrando praesentem'.
Lviv councilman issuing the acquittance: 'Spectabilis Dominus Gaspar Gulinski Collega noster Consularis palam publice benevoleque recognouit'.
Council authority referenced via its acts: 'in iisdem Actis iuris Consularibus Inseinserata'.

mention_texts: quingentos florenos pecuniae et numeri Polonicalis
entities.justification: Sum paid and acknowledged: 'se recepisse levasse ac plenarie numerasse quingentos florenos pecuniae et numeri Polonicalis'.
Citizen of Lviv paying the sum: 'a Famato Sebastiano Karczewic Cive Leopoliensi'.
City of Sebastian's citizenship and location of the house: 'Cive Leopoliensi', 'hic Leopoli consistenti'.
Wife of Sebastianus Karczewic, formerly surnamed Turska: 'ab Honesta Dorothea fratrum legitima ipsius coniuge, olim vero primarum nuptiarum Turska nuncupata'.
Street where the house is situated: 'in platea Pistorum hic Leopoli consistenti'.
Stone house bought on Bakers' Street: 'domus lapideae in platea Pistorum hic Leopoli consistenti Strobnikowska vocata'.
